# DEGENCARDS

> DEGENCARDS (also written Degen Cards or DegenCards) is a free web app at https://degencards.vercel.app/ that turns every Solana trade into a collectible card. Paste a Solana wallet address (watch-only, no signature, no seed phrase) and closed trades are imported automatically, with the coin, its logo, entry, exit, hold time, profit and the real price chart with buy and sell markers.

## What it does
- Auto-import of Solana trades from a public wallet address: Pump.fun, Axiom, Photon, BullX, GMGN, Fomo, Phantom, Solflare, Backpack. Read-only, cannot move funds.
- PnL cards with the real candle chart: story 9:16 and post 4:5, ready for X, TikTok, Instagram and Telegram.
- Animated cards and trade replay videos (the trade rebuilt candle by candle, with live PnL).
- Collection: every trade gets a rarity (common to mythic), a grade and achievements.
- Weekly leaderboard ranked on real on-chain profit, with usernames.
- Stats and trading journal: win rate, P&L calendar, monthly goal.
- Radar: live Solana memecoins with an on-chain safety score (mint and freeze authority, bundles, holders, dev wallet, liquidity, RugCheck).
- PRO Screener: a memecoin checklist applied automatically (meta leader, already pumped, volume spike, copycats, pump.fun launch pace).
- Coin launcher: launch a coin with one wallet signature, non-custodial.

## Pricing
- Free: auto-import, cards, PnL cards, animated cards, trade replays.
- PRO: replay customization, advanced stats, PRO Screener.
